Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000247, which was taken on 2014-10-30. The amount in dispute is $338.43. According to our records, the correct spoils allowance for this store and period is $231.80 (0.0100 of $23,180.28 invoiced). Therefore, the amount to repay is $106.63. The dispute deadline was 2015-04-28, and this deadline has passed. Please review the claim and provide your response.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
